items.text: The focused responsibility map covers SOW-230 and the named shared contract interfaces, separates concepts/guidance/technical commitments, and gives each affected contribution a supported owner and consuming contract or an explicit unresolved allocation. Verified by VER-001.

verification.text: Inspect the assembled map against BASIS SOW-230 and the CLM-001–006 owner/interface statements. Follow each affected entry to its accepted contract source; compare meaning, ownership, consumer and open allocation. Record omissions, contradictory assignments and the candidate identity supporting AC-001.

items.text: Every promise affected by the bounded renewal retains its accepted identity, current decision-qualified obligation, accountable SoW and derivative/evaluation path; unavailable artifacts and open choices are visible without a silently lost or weakened promise. Verified by VER-002.

verification.text: Perform a two-way comparison between the bounded population of affected accepted promises and OUT-002. Follow each source obligation through later qualifying decisions to its SoW, derivative/interface and evaluation path, then reverse-check account entries for unsupported promises. Examine absent derivative and relocation cases explicitly; record retained obligations, missing links and owning points of need for AC-002.

items.text: Every historical statement included in the account has a supported present-applicability treatment and preserved original reference; thesis continuity and another consumer's ongoing obligations are retained, and superseded seed defaults do not reappear as current requirements. Verified by VER-003.

verification.text: Compare applicability entries to original records and later accepted direction, including SEED's Root-first precedence, thin-loop default and shared TypeScript wording against HTML/OPS/ARCH. Confirm original/thesis preservation references and identify any current consumer obligation that continues despite v4's different direction. Treat historical successful repairs as bounded evidence, not topology-only proof or a v4 qualification. Record the comparison supporting AC-003.

items.text: For each proposed affected placement/supply change, the account provides identified current-source consumer/packaging/tool-path checks or an explicit outstanding check and point-of-need hold; it does not assert adoption, runtime delivery or behavior from source inspection. Verified by VER-004.

verification.text: Inspect the selected current source/selector/tool-path chain for each affected placement or supply change, starting from relevant known leads such as CLM-007. Compare proposed placement with actual references and supplied-basis identity; name each affected Root/Runtime/App/Piping consumer and owner. Separate static trace from build/runtime evidence; an unavailable check records the gap and prevents the affected placement/supply reliance, without stopping independent definition. Return source identities, findings and limits for AC-004; execute no network experiment or consumer migration under this contract-initialization task.

items.text: The account maps compatible workflow, identity, human-act, catalog and evidence obligations to their actual App/shared/host owners, retains the chosen Codex/Tauri/minimal-loop direction, and leaves unjustified common execution and open placement unselected. Verified by VER-005.

verification.text: Review the account against the PKG-02/03/04/05 accepted interface rows and ARCH decisions. Check workflow/checkpoint, identity, human-act, catalog and evidence coverage, the retained App/host direction, and whether proposed common implementation has a concrete repeated responsibility and named consumers. Compare all placement choices to TBD-001/002 so an open choice remains open. Record compatibility questions and owner decisions needed for AC-005; an interface comparison alone is not a joined-product pass.

items.text: The account preserves the excluded acts and owners in REQ-006 and attributes actual acts only to their evidence: faithful recording of an actually performed human act is distinguishable from fabrication and from the recorder, while execution/checking/acceptance/approval/reliance/adoption are not inferred from one another. Verified by VER-006.

verification.text: Examine each exclusion in REQ-006 against the act its cited claim assigns, including non-deliverable human/host owners. Inspect actual-act statements and their custody. Use a positive documentary case of an actually performed human decision faithfully recorded with distinct actor/recorder and identified subject; use negative cases where a successful operation, check, prepared notice or silent interval is incorrectly presented as acceptance/adoption/reliance. Confirm rejection of those unsupported inferences without denying faithful recording or imposing an unaccepted order among distinct acts. Record the semantic comparison supporting AC-006.
